name: Shree Bohara
title: Software Engineer
summary: I build full-stack products and tools for evaluating AI systems

highlights: Built an incident-analysis pipeline that groups production errors and grounds model analysis in source files. It runs in dev and stage while observing production data.
Designed and shipped a consent-state workflow with idempotent capture, transactional audit records and post-commit notification handling.
Co-architected the platform and built multi-step onboarding with address autocomplete, dependent vehicle selection and policy-document import.
Built the rating engine in Java and Spring Boot to connect the product's insurance workflow to rate APIs.
Built health-record exchange APIs and interfaces in Node.js, React and MySQL, standardizing records around FHIR resources.
Improved service responsiveness with query optimization and Redis caching, and added structured logging and distributed tracing.

projects.title: FaultLab
projects.summary: A team-built, AI-assisted lab for testing LLM agents under tool failures, with fixed-code checks and fresh challenges before a proposed repair can replace the baseline.

projects.title: Algorithmic Options Trading System
projects.summary: Live execution was disabled in recorded sessions. This Python and React tooling encodes a trader’s method, keeps uncertain order state explicit and has a public engineering write-up.

projects.title: CodebaseQA
projects.summary: Codebase exploration with source-cited answers, guided learning and an interactive dependency graph, built around repository code instead of architecture guesses.
